## Goal

Describe the user or operational outcome.

## Requirements

List requirement and acceptance-criteria IDs.

## Changed Modules

List affected applications and packages.

## Migrations

Describe migration order, compatibility window, and whether the change is expand or contract.

## API and Scenarios

Describe API, webhook, job, event, Telegram flow, and scenario compatibility.

## Tests

List lint, typecheck, unit, integration, contract, E2E, and migration results.

## Manual Verification

List reproducible staging or local checks.

## Rollback

Describe code rollback and forward-fix or database recovery plan.

## UI Evidence

Attach desktop and mobile screenshots for UI changes, or state not applicable.

## Risks

Describe security, data, financial, concurrency, and operational risks.
